verdict.rationale: Otter's own marketing says deal details, notes, and next steps are automatically extracted and synced to your CRM, and its pricing page lists Salesforce and HubSpot integrations (asterisked, suggesting conditions). There is no documentation of how notes are matched to the right contact or deal records, no Attio support, and no hands-on corroboration; the AI Chat CRM integration is described as querying the CRM, not writing to it. Missing for 10: documented mapping of notes and summaries onto specific contact and deal records, Attio integration, detailed first-party integration docs or tier conditions, independent or hands-on confirmation of the automatic sync.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

citations.quote: Key deal details, notes, and next steps automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM.
